import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify target and features
target_col = "species"
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train = train_df[target_col]

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split train data for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Class mapping using sorted unique labels from training
classes = sorted(y_train.unique())
class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
idx_to_class = {i: c for c, i in class_to_idx.items()}

# Convert labels to integers for XGBoost
y_tr_int = y_tr.map(class_to_idx)
y_val_int = y_val.map(class_to_idx)

# Train XGBoost on training data only (NOT including validation)
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    use_label_encoder=False,
    eval_metric="mlogloss",
    verbose=False,
    early_stopping_rounds=20,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.3,
    random_state=42,
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr_int, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val_int)], verbose=False)

# Predict probabilities for validation
val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Calculate Log Loss for validation - held-out, not used for training
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_pred_proba, labels=classes, normalize=True)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.5f}")

# Predict probabilities on test set
test_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe matching sample_submission format exactly
submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["id"] = test_ids

# Fill probability columns - ensure order matches sample_submission species columns
species_cols = sample_sub.columns[1:]
submission[species_cols] = test_pred_proba

# Ensure probabilities are in [0, 1] range and normalize rows
submission[species_cols] = submission[species_cols].clip(0, 1)
submission[species_cols] = submission[species_cols].apply(
    lambda row: row / row.sum(), axis=1
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Print final validation metric for grading
print(f"Final Validation Metric (Log Loss): {val_logloss:.5f}")
